classification: Explicitly unfinished effects, shown as inactive in game tooltips; not a newly introduced regression. Weapon hit procs are implemented and excluded.
denominator: Actual newly acquired expedition loot plus opened first-clear chest items captured by the observer; each account UID counted once. Starting gear and unacquired monster gear excluded.
sourceFlags: snapshot/src/ui/mock.js:195-199 and item.js:28; runtime hero.js:672 only collects weapon hit procs.
notes: Auto-equipped-at-least-once is joined to actual automatic equip events; it is not proof that the inactive line caused the choice.
This observational sample does not estimate all player distributions. Observer/main parity must be checked by the simulation owner.
Phases are cumulative and must not be added together.
